check('plain digits', lambda: parse_int("42"), 42)
check('whitespace is allowed', lambda: parse_int(" 7\n"), 7)
check('negative', lambda: parse_int("-5"), -5)
check('a float string is not an int', lambda: parse_int("4.2"), None)
check('empty string', lambda: parse_int(""), None)
check('None', lambda: parse_int(None), None)
check('thousands separator is rejected', lambda: parse_int("1,000"), None)

check('normal division', lambda: safe_divide(7, 2), 3.5)
check('zero denominator', lambda: safe_divide(1, 0), None)
check('custom default', lambda: safe_divide(1, 0, 0.0), 0.0)
check('None numerator', lambda: safe_divide(None, 3), None)
check('negative', lambda: safe_divide(-9, 3), -3.0)
check('zero numerator', lambda: safe_divide(0, 5), 0.0)

check('two lines with tax', lambda: invoice_total([(2, "19.99"), (1, "5.01")], "0.2"), Decimal('53.99'))
check('no lines', lambda: invoice_total([], "0.2"), Decimal('0.00'))
check('no tax', lambda: invoice_total([(3, "0.10")], "0"), Decimal('0.30'))
check('half-up rounding', lambda: invoice_total([(1, "0.125")], "0"), Decimal('0.13'))
check('float trap avoided', lambda: invoice_total([(1, "0.1"), (1, "0.2")], "0"), Decimal('0.30'))
check('large quantity', lambda: invoice_total([(1000, "9.99")], "0.075"), Decimal('10739.25'))

check('2.675 to cents', lambda: round_half_up(2.675, 2), Decimal('2.68'))
check('0.5 to an integer', lambda: round_half_up(0.5, 0), Decimal('1'))
check('2.5 to an integer', lambda: round_half_up(2.5, 0), Decimal('3'))
check('negative half', lambda: round_half_up(-1.5, 0), Decimal('-2'))
check('string input', lambda: round_half_up("1.005", 2), Decimal('1.01'))
check('int input', lambda: round_half_up(3, 2), Decimal('3.00'))

check('one hour, one minute, one second', lambda: hms(3661), '1:01:01')
check('zero', lambda: hms(0), '0:00:00')
check('under a minute', lambda: hms(59), '0:00:59')
check('exact hour', lambda: hms(3600), '1:00:00')
check('more than a day', lambda: hms(90061), '25:01:01')
check('59:59', lambda: hms(3599), '0:59:59')

check('0.1 + 0.2 vs 0.3', lambda: same_amount(0.1 + 0.2, 0.3), True)
check('clearly different', lambda: same_amount(1.0, 1.1), False)
check('near zero', lambda: same_amount(1e-12, 0.0), True)
check('large values', lambda: same_amount(1e12 + 0.0001, 1e12), True)
check('nan is never equal', lambda: same_amount(float("nan"), float("nan")), False)
check('negatives', lambda: same_amount(-0.3, -(0.1 + 0.2)), True)

check('skips None', lambda: coalesce(None, 3), 3)
check('keeps zero', lambda: coalesce(0, 5), 0)
check('keeps empty string', lambda: coalesce("", "x"), '')
check('all None', lambda: coalesce(None, None), None)
check('no arguments', lambda: coalesce(), None)
check('keeps False', lambda: coalesce(None, False, True), False)

check('true', lambda: parse_bool("true"), True)
check('mixed case and spaces', lambda: parse_bool("  YES "), True)
check('zero', lambda: parse_bool("0"), False)
check('n', lambda: parse_bool("N"), False)
check('False string', lambda: parse_bool("False"), False)
check('junk raises', lambda: raises(lambda: parse_bool("maybe"), ValueError), True)
check('empty raises', lambda: raises(lambda: parse_bool(""), ValueError), True)

check('growth', lambda: pct_change(200, 250), 25.0)
check('decline', lambda: pct_change(80, 60), -25.0)
check('zero baseline', lambda: pct_change(0, 5), None)
check('missing new', lambda: pct_change(10, None), None)
check('no change', lambda: pct_change(7, 7), 0.0)
check('negative baseline', lambda: pct_change(-50, -25), -50.0)

check('positive', lambda: div_trunc(7, 2), 3)
check('negative dividend', lambda: div_trunc(-7, 2), -3)
check('negative divisor', lambda: div_trunc(7, -2), -3)
check('both negative', lambda: div_trunc(-7, -2), 3)
check('exact', lambda: div_trunc(-8, 2), -4)
check('huge ints stay exact', lambda: div_trunc(-(10**30) - 1, 10**15), -1000000000000000)

check('currency and separator', lambda: parse_amount("$1,204.50"), Decimal('1204.50'))
check('brackets mean negative', lambda: parse_amount("(30.00)"), Decimal('-30.00'))
check('minus sign', lambda: parse_amount("-7"), Decimal('-7'))
check('plain', lambda: parse_amount("0.10"), Decimal('0.10'))
check('spaces', lambda: parse_amount("  12 "), Decimal('12'))
check('junk raises', lambda: raises(lambda: parse_amount("N/A"), ValueError), True)

check('skips None', lambda: mean_present([1, None, 3]), 2.0)
check('all missing', lambda: mean_present([None, None]), None)
check('empty', lambda: mean_present([]), None)
check('zeros count', lambda: mean_present([0, 0, 3]), 1.0)
check('single', lambda: mean_present([5]), 5.0)
check('floats', lambda: mean_present([0.5, 1.5]), 1.0)

check('zero', lambda: to_base36(0), '0')
check('35 is z', lambda: to_base36(35), 'z')
check('36 is 10', lambda: to_base36(36), '10')
check('a known value', lambda: to_base36(1295), 'zz')
check('round trip', lambda: int(to_base36(123456789), 36), 123456789)
check('large', lambda: to_base36(2**64), '3w5e11264sgsg')
